beatoven-ai-api.notes: Auth and endpoints are documented in the public API spec on GitHub (Beatoven/public-api); free-credit amount is not disclosed on public pages.

elevenlabs-music-api.free_tier: Free tier: 10,000 credits per month shared with TTS (music included, no commercial use of music on Free; Starter $6/mo or higher needed)
elevenlabs-music-api.notes: Endpoint POST /v1/music; models music_v1/v2/v2.5; billed from the same ElevenLabs credit pool as TTS. The local elevenlabs-mcp repo is deprecated in favor of the hosted OAuth MCP server.

soundraw-api.free_tier: Trial: one-time 2-week free API trial with no commitment; then Starter $29.99/mo for 100 songs with a 6-month minimum commitment

airtable-api.free_tier: Free tier: 1,000 API calls per workspace per month on the Free plan, 5 req/sec per base

asana-api.notes: Official remote MCP server uses OAuth; MCP tokens work only with the MCP server, not the REST API.

box-api.free_tier: Free: developer plan with 10 GB storage, full API access and 1,000 AI units per month, no payment required

calendly-api.free_tier: Free: API GET/POST works on every plan incl. Free (except 3 Enterprise-only endpoints); webhooks need a Standard, Teams or Enterprise plan

clickup-api.notes: MCP server is OAuth-only (no API keys); Free Forever is limited to 50 MCP calls per 24h without the AI add-on.

coda-api-superhuman-docs.notes: Coda was rebranded to 'Superhuman Docs' after Grammarly's acquisition; the API base URL (coda.io/apis/v1) still works. The official MCP server uses OAuth via id.superhuman.com (scope mcp:all).

dropbox-api.notes: Official remote MCP server is in open beta and uses Dropbox OAuth.

linear-api.auth_hint: Authorization: <API_KEY> (personal key, no Bearer) or Authorization: Bearer <OAuth2 token>

google-workspace-apis-gmail-calendar-dri.free_tier: Free: no charge within per-API daily quotas; Google plans to bill quota overages to the Cloud billing account later in 2026
google-workspace-apis-gmail-calendar-dri.notes: Each Workspace API (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) has its own quota; sensitive/restricted scopes require OAuth consent screen verification. Official remote MCP servers (Developer Preview, OAuth) run per product, e.g. gmailmcp.googleapis.com/mcp/v1.

microsoft-graph-outlook-teams-onedrive.notes: Requires app registration in Microsoft Entra ID; delegated vs application permissions determine required consent. The official MCP Server for Enterprise (preview) only runs read-only Entra directory queries.

monday-com-api.notes: Hosted MCP accepts a personal API token or OAuth 2.0; SSE transport is deprecated in favor of Streamable HTTP.

trello-api.auth_hint: key=<API_KEY>&token=<API_TOKEN> query params, or Authorization: OAuth oauth_consumer_key="<API_KEY>", oauth_token="<API_TOKEN>"
trello-api.notes: Now documented under the Atlassian developer platform; REST calls send an API key plus a user token (no Bearer). The official MCP server uses OAuth 2.0 and works on all Trello plans.

ayrshare.free_tier: Trial: one-time 28-day free trial of the Launch plan ($299/mo), no card required; Premium from $149/mo
ayrshare.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>; since 2026-03-31 X/Twitter requests also need X-Twitter-OAuth1-Api-Key and X-Twitter-OAuth1-Api-Secret headers
ayrshare.notes: Ayrshare holds most per-platform app approvals, so agents avoid applying for Meta/TikTok developer access (X now needs your own X app keys). Action MCP has 27 tools with API-key auth.

meta-graph-api-facebook-instagram.notes: Most useful permissions (posting, Instagram content, insights) require Meta App Review; basic/dev-mode access is limited to admins/testers. The official MCP covers ads, catalogs and reporting only, not organic posting.

tiktok-api.free_tier: Free: no fee; requires app review for production access, sandbox mode for testing; posts from unaudited clients are private-only until the app passes TikTok's audit

x-twitter-api.free_tier: Paid only: pay-per-usage with prepaid credits (e.g. $0.005 per Post read, $0.001 per owned read), no subscriptions and no free tier
x-twitter-api.notes: Credits are deducted per request; pay-per-usage is capped at 3M Post reads per billing cycle, higher volumes need an Enterprise plan. The official xurl bridge (xdevplatform) handles OAuth for the MCP server.

youtube-data-api.free_tier: Free tier: 10,000 quota units/day plus separate caps of 100 search.list and 100 videos.insert calls/day (extendable on request)
